title: The 1973 Oil Shock as a Linked-System Crisis
sourceLabel: 既存教材をTOEFL形式へ変換 · 元の問1–9に対応
verificationNote: 四つの原文段落と全九つの学習対象を保持し、元の記述問題を英語四択へ変換しました。

passages.text:
In October 1973, Egypt and Syria attacked Israeli forces, beginning a war in a region central to world oil supply. The fighting and the diplomatic responses of outside powers formed the political setting for an energy crisis, but war itself did not physically remove every barrel from the global market.

Arab oil-exporting states used production cuts and an embargo against selected countries to exert political pressure. These measures must be distinguished from every decision made by OPEC as a whole. At the same time, posted prices and market expectations changed sharply. The crisis was therefore produced by interacting political decisions, supply restrictions, pricing power, and fear of further shortage.

Oil-importing economies faced higher energy costs, inflation, disrupted production, and weaker growth. The effects differed by energy dependence, industrial structure, inventories, exchange rates, and domestic policy. Governments introduced conservation measures, reconsidered energy security, and developed or expanded institutions such as strategic reserves and international coordination.

The phrase “the oil shock” can conceal both internal complexity and later events. A second major disruption followed the Iranian Revolution in 1979. Combining 1973 and 1979 erases different causes and responses. The broader lesson is not that one resource mechanically controls history, but that concentrated supply, low short-run substitutability, expectations, and geopolitical decisions can transmit a regional conflict through the world economy.

questions.prompt: What is the main idea of the passage?

options.label: A
options.text: The 1973 war and every oil-market decision were the same event.

options.label: B
options.text: The crisis spread through linked political, supply, price, expectation, and policy mechanisms.

options.label: C
options.text: Every importing country experienced an identical economic effect.

options.label: D
options.text: The 1973 and 1979 disruptions had exactly the same cause.

questions.answer: 正解：B。政治判断、供給制限、価格決定力、期待、政策反応が連動した危機として説明しています。Aは層を混同し、Cは条件差、Dは別の原因を消します。

questions.prompt: How does the passage distinguish the war from the oil-supply measures?

options.label: A
options.text: The war created the political setting, while production cuts and selective embargoes were additional policy decisions that restricted supply.

options.label: B
options.text: The war physically eliminated every barrel of oil from the global market.

options.label: C
options.text: The embargo began before any political setting existed and targeted no countries.

options.label: D
options.text: The fighting and every supply decision were one mechanically identical action.

questions.answer: 正解：A。戦争は政治的背景を作りましたが、実際の供給縮小には輸出国による減産・選択的禁輸という追加決定がありました。B～Dは因果の中間段階を消します。

questions.prompt: The word “substitutability” in paragraph 4 is closest in meaning to

options.label: A
options.text: the ease of replacing one input with another

options.label: B
options.text: the certainty that prices never change

options.label: C
options.text: legal ownership of all oil fields

options.label: D
options.text: the speed of military surrender

questions.answer: 正解：A。substitutabilityは、ある投入物を別のものへ置き換えられる度合いです。短期に石油から代替しにくいほど衝撃が伝わりやすく、B～Dは文脈と無関係です。

questions.prompt: Why would it be too imprecise to say only that “OPEC uniformly embargoed the United States”?

options.label: A
options.text: It fails to distinguish political measures by Arab exporting states from decisions of the broader OPEC membership.

options.label: B
options.text: OPEC included no oil-exporting countries in 1973.

options.label: C
options.text: All countries in the world imposed exactly the same embargo.

options.label: D
options.text: The passage says that no production cut or embargo occurred.

questions.answer: 正解：A。アラブ輸出国による政治的な禁輸・減産と、より広い加盟国を持つOPEC全体の決定は主体範囲が異なります。B～Dは本文の事実を否定または過度に一般化します。

questions.prompt: Which set of conditions does the passage identify as shaping differences among importing countries?

options.label: A
options.text: Energy dependence, industrial structure, inventories, exchange rates, and domestic policy

options.label: B
options.text: Only the distance from the battlefield

options.label: C
options.text: Identical inventories and identical policy in every country

options.label: D
options.text: The number of speeches made by oil-company executives

questions.answer: 正解：A。輸入依存度、産業構造、在庫、為替、国内政策が同じ外部ショックへの影響差を作ります。Bは単一要因、Cは差を否定し、Dは本文にありません。

questions.prompt: Which choice best distinguishes short-term from medium- and long-term policy responses?

options.label: A
options.text: Short-term conservation and inventory use; longer-term reserves, diversification, efficiency, alternatives, and coordination

options.label: B
options.text: Short-term dependence on one supplier; longer-term elimination of every reserve

options.label: C
options.text: No short-term response; permanent rejection of energy policy

options.label: D
options.text: Immediate replacement of all oil infrastructure, followed by greater concentration

questions.answer: 正解：A。短期には節約・需要抑制・在庫利用、中長期には備蓄・供給分散・効率化・代替エネルギー・国際協調が対応します。B～Dはレジリエンスを弱めるか時間軸を無視します。

questions.prompt: Why is it misleading to combine the disruptions of 1973 and 1979 into one undifferentiated shock?

options.label: A
options.text: Doing so erases differences in causes, actors, and responses: war and political supply measures in 1973 versus disruption after the Iranian Revolution in 1979.

options.label: B
options.text: Both disruptions occurred on the same day for exactly the same reason.

options.label: C
options.text: The 1979 disruption had no connection to oil supply.

options.label: D
options.text: The 1973 crisis occurred after the 1979 revolution.

questions.answer: 正解：A。1973年は戦争と輸出国の政治措置、1979年はイラン革命後の供給混乱が中心で、統合すると原因・主体・対応の比較を失います。B～Dは年代や因果に反します。

questions.prompt: What causal oversimplification is rejected by the sentence “War itself did not physically remove every barrel from the global market”?

options.label: A
options.text: The claim that war alone caused the supply reduction without intervening policy and market decisions

options.label: B
options.text: The claim that political decisions can affect energy markets

options.label: C
options.text: The claim that some importing economies faced higher costs

options.label: D
options.text: The claim that a barrel is a unit used for oil

questions.answer: 正解：A。戦争から供給減へ中間決定なしに直結させる説明を否定し、減産・禁輸・価格・期待という媒介を示します。BとCは本文が支持し、Dは因果主張ではありません。

questions.prompt: Why is a country's energy-security resilience not adequately measured by self-sufficiency alone?

options.label: A
options.text: Resilience also depends on supplier diversity, reserves, demand flexibility, infrastructure, substitutability, recovery time, and distributional cost.

options.label: B
options.text: Domestic production eliminates every dependence on equipment, finance, and transport.

options.label: C
options.text: Importing energy always makes resilience impossible regardless of institutions.

options.label: D
options.text: A single production percentage fully describes every link in the energy system.

questions.answer: 正解：A。自給率以外にも供給源分散、備蓄、需要柔軟性、インフラ、代替可能性、復旧時間、費用配分がレジリエンスを左右します。B～Dは相互依存する系を単一指標へ還元します。
